name: Impressive Monet & Brilliant Klimt
description: Step inside the paintings of two modern masters in this breathtaking immersive experience at the Alfândega do Porto.
longDescription:
"Impressive Monet & Brilliant Klimt" is an immersive art exhibition presented at the Immersivus Gallery Porto, located within the historic Alfândega do Porto. This digital art experience projects the works of Claude Monet and Gustav Klimt onto large-scale surfaces, allowing viewers to engage with the art in a multi-sensory environment. The exhibition focuses on the distinct styles and periods of these two influential artists, showcasing their contributions to Impressionism and Symbolism respectively through animated projections and accompanying soundscapes.

Visitors will find themselves surrounded by the projected artworks, which transition and evolve across the gallery's walls and floor. The experience is designed to offer a different perspective on the artists' oeuvres, moving beyond traditional framed presentations. The historic setting of the Alfândega do Porto, a grand former customs house, provides a notable backdrop for the contemporary digital art display. The exhibition runs for a limited period, from September 3rd to September 9th, 2026.

The Immersivus Gallery Porto is situated at the Alfândega do Porto, accessible via various public transport options. It is a short walk from the Ribeira district. Specific ticketing information, including purchase points and availability, would be advised closer to the event date.
